**Finding submitted — deviation (NOSOLICIT).**

- **Only responsive clause:** § 12.4 (p0045). Searches for "solicit", "no-hire", "induce … to leave", and "employ or engage" returned no other covenant; nothing cross-references § 12.4.
- **Why it fails fallback (and is walk-away):** one-way on Customer, covers *any* Vendor employee, 24 months post-term, expressly a no-hire ("hire, or employ"), and no general-advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies"). It also contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer made "no … no-hire commitment".
- **Cure (preferred level):** single minimal edit to the prohibitory operator and duration — "Customer **may** solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee." — so Customer carries no non-solicitation restriction, with the fallback offered in the comment. Redline validated `ok:true` with minimality passing.
